patch_description: Replace the random point sample with a deterministic multi-start simulated-annealing construction. The search directly evaluates all 286 triangle areas, normalizes by the convex-hull area used by the scorer, and retains the best configuration found. A lower-tail objective (minimum area plus a small reward for the next-smallest triangles) avoids local optima where only one nearly degenerate triangle is repaired at the expense of several others. All candidate points are clipped to a fixed square, so they remain in a convex region throughout, while normalization makes the particular square scale irrelevant.
